answer: Identity bonds that decay stop fake identities. An agent posts a bond of twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, losing 5 percent each epoch unless honest work renews it. Each epoch a beacon flashes verified agents, and only their bonds stop decaying, like handling that keeps jade polished and walnut shells hard. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 200 months of earnings, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
